name: ci-light
description: Know when main is broken before you build on it: a red row above the prompt says how long your repo's default branch has been failing CI and how many pushes landed on top, and the agent is told too.

workflow.title: Only these workflows
workflow.description: Comma-separated workflow names or files (e.g. "ci" or "ci.yml") that decide red or green. Empty counts every workflow on the default branch.
